He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant…

translations.web: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
translations.bsb: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.”
translations.kjv: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
